text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000163 bills 99215 far above expectation in every complexity stratum, but the small set of returned charts supports the billed levels, so the evidence currently conflicts.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The elevation survives risk adjustment and appears at every complexity level, including patients with no chronic conditions (12.5% vs 1.8% for all providers), so a sicker panel alone does not explain the pattern. Sampled low-complexity 99215s include an upper respiratory infection (C0077966, C0078036, C0078209) and a follow-up visit (C0078001, C0078147), which is a pattern consistent with upcoding. Against that, all 7 documented 99215 claims were supported at high MDM, including C0078017, a single-condition diabetes visit, though 7 charts are too few to settle the question. Most supported notes have no recorded minutes, and the 2 data-reviewed notes without a lab or test line are only weak evidence of inflated or cloned notes. A reviewer should first request charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims listed in the packet and check whether the high-MDM notes for simple visits (for example C0078017) reflect real decision-making or templated text."}
